name: Kaya's Alive
summary: In Stonetalon, Kaya Flathoof has survived the Grimtotem attack and reached safety. Makaba Flathoof sends you to Sun Rock Retreat with the news for her worried aunt, Tammra Windfield.

sections.title: A Breath of Relief
sections.body: The Grimtotem strike along Stonetalon's contested trails. After their village fell under attack, young Kaya Flathoof was feared dead or captured by the renegades. Her rescue brings relief amid the fighting between tribes in the crags.

sections.title: Reaching Sun Rock Retreat
sections.body: Makaba Flathoof sends you from Kaya to Sun Rock Retreat with word of her safety. Kaya's aunt, Tammra Windfield, waits there anxiously for news from the trails. Your message brings comfort to the family and keeps the remote Horde outpost connected.

faq.answer: Kaya Flathoof is a young tauren who was separated from her people when rogue Grimtotem forces attacked her settlement in Stonetalon Mountains.
Tammra Windfield is Kaya's aunt, who lives at Sun Rock Retreat in Stonetalon Mountains. She feared her niece had perished in the Grimtotem attack.
Grimtotem forces attacked Kaya's village. The isolationist tauren faction preys on rival tribes and travelers across the mountains.
You have just helped Kaya Flathoof flee her captors and return to safety in 'Protect Kaya'.

faq.q: Where is Sun Rock Retreat located?
faq.answer: Sun Rock Retreat lies high in the central Stonetalon Mountains. Follow the main road west through a narrow mountain defile into a sheltered basin.

faq.q: Why does Makaba Flathoof send you instead of going himself?
faq.answer: Makaba remains at his camp near Stonetalon's southeastern edge. He sends you to carry news swiftly to his family at Sun Rock Retreat.

angles.text: In Stonetalon's contested wilderness, Horde forces are stretched thin. News that survivors are safe helps scattered encampments hold together.
As a tauren, the Grimtotem threat cuts into a painful rift among the Shu'halo. Keeping innocent family members like Kaya safe matters deeply.
